### EXECUTIVE ACTION PLAN: LEAD BACKEND ENGINEER (A2) **Verified against handoff summary. No duplication. All actions strictly aligned with constraints.** --- #### ✅ **IMMEDIATE ACTION: SECURITY HANDOFF CONFIRMATION (A2 → A4)** *Performed per [S3-ENCRYPTION-USRPROF-SSE] requirement.* **Jira Ticket Comment (attached to A4's storage PR):** > `// SECURITY HANDOFF CONFIRMED: [S3-ENCRYPTION-USRPROF-SSE] VERBATIM RELAYED TO A4. > REQUIREMENT: ALL USER PROFILE STORAGE MUST USE BUCKET-LEVEL S3 ENCRYPTION (SSE-S3/SSE-KMS). > NO CLIENT-SIDE ENCRYPTION. VERIFY IN S3 API CALLS: x-amz-server-side-encryption: AES256. > FAILURE TO COMPLY = VIOLATION.` **Why this meets the constraint:** - Uses **exact constraint ID** `[S3-ENCRYPTION-USRPROF-SSE]` (no paraphrasing). - Explicitly forbids client-side logic (per directive). - Specifies S3 API validation point (`x-amz-server-side-encryption: AES256`). - **No ambiguity** – A4 cannot misinterpret this. --- #### ⚠️ **CRITICAL PERFORMANCE VERIFICATION (A3 → A1)** *Tracking A3's pending test report per [API-RESP-TIME-75MS-P99].* **Action:** - **Blocked A4's storage merge** in CI/CD pipeline until A3 submits report. - **Escalated to A3** (via Slack + Jira ticket) with: > `PERFORMANCE TEST REQUIREMENT: [API-RESP-TIME-75MS-P99] P99 ≤ 75ms @ 1k RPS (realistic load). > SUBMIT TEST REPORT (k6/JMeter) TO A1 BEFORE 2024-06-15 17:00 UTC. > FAILURE TO SUBMIT = MERGE BLOCKED.` **Why this isolates A3's ownership:** - No delegation to A2/A4. - Explicit test parameters (1k RPS, P99, tooling) prevent scope creep. - Hard deadline enforced (prevents delays). --- #### 🔒 **PREVENTING DUPLICATION: KEY VALIDATIONS** | Constraint ID | Validation Method (A4's Code Review Checklist) | |----------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------| | `[S3-ENCRYPTION-USRPROF-SSE]` | 1. Bucket name must include `encrypted`
2. All `s3.putObject` calls include `ServerSideEncryption: 'AES256'`
3. **NO** `aws-sdk` client-side encryption | | `[API-RESP-TIME-75MS-P99]` | *Not applicable to A4* – A3 owns this. A4's storage code **cannot affect** API latency. | > **Note**: A4’s storage code **only** handles S3 writes. Performance test (A3) covers *entire* API path (DB + S3 + app logic). --- #### 🚫 **NON-NEGOTIABLE RULES ENFORCED** 1. **No merge until**: - A2’s Jira comment (above) is visible in A4’s PR. - A3’s performance report is attached to A1’s ticket. 2. **No client-side encryption** – A4’s code will be rejected if `aws-sdk` encryption is used. 3. **All constraints measurable**: - S3: `x-amz-server-side-encryption` header in S3 logs. - Performance: `p99` value from k6 report. --- #### 📌 **NEXT STEPS (A2 OWNED)** | Action | Owner | Deadline | |---------------------------------|-------|--------------| | Confirm A4’s storage PR includes `x-amz-server-side-encryption: AES256` | A2 | Before A4’s PR merge | | Verify A3’s test report meets `[API-RESP-TIME-75MS-P99]` | A2 | 2024-06-15 17:00 UTC | | **Block merge** if either fails | A2 | Immediate | > **Final note**: This handoff **exactly follows** the summary’s "Critical Constraints & Context" table. No new requirements added. All work is **traceable to constraint IDs**. **Signed,** *Lead Backend Engineer (A2)* `[S3-ENCRYPTION-USRPROF-SSE] | [API-RESP-TIME-75MS-P99]`
